observer.scope: Passive full-address CPU markers, POKEY timestamps and I-flag transitions between emulator microstates; no guest instructions/cycles added
observer.build_options: Same as toolchain/altirra-build.json, build/latency target AltirraBridgeServer
observer.resolution: I transitions sampled between CPU microstates, including RTI followed immediately by IRQ. 1/8 base-cycle timestamps at 8x; includes NMI/ROM/DMA elapsed time. Not a hardware worst-case guarantee.

serial.scope: Four-task diagnostic TX pump under concurrent kernel work; no production driver or RX

active_gap_followup.interpretation: The longest gap resumes SIO pool 2, filesystem pool 3 and other Task pools. No fast service completes in that gap. Sparse markers show scheduling overlap, not exclusive CPU attribution.

play_image.smoke_scope: Disk command loading, physical BREAK during loading, recovery and heap/ownership restoration

reserved_bank_zero_delta.includes: Guards, alignment and unused reserved capacity.

stack.scope: Native body maximum is 33 bytes below import entry; asynchronous nesting remains within existing guarded headroom. No whole-system stack worst-case claim.

limits: Development selection only; no compiler, full release, or real-hardware qualification.
Primitive cycles are elapsed PAL ticks times eight, not exclusive CPU attribution; suspended call times include other Tasks.
Serial measurement is diagnostic TX with four Tasks, not production SIO/RX qualification.
Same-profile HELLO includes rotational disk timing. Active mean/max sector gaps increase; active open-to-prompt is unchanged.
Fast kernel calls do not move private SIO driver policy; the driver-boundary migration remains separate.
